name: The Completed Robe
label: Quest
description: The Completed Robe: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will put the robe together for you now. It will take but a few moments. Do not go far.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is done, friend. Here you are. Wear it with pride.

You've worked hard and I see great things in your future. Remember, to defy the corruption that comes with our path takes great will and fortitude. As long as your will is your own, then you shall have great success.
